liveChecks: Loaded the updated interface with no captured browser errors or warnings.
DLPFC view: Show labels off hides all floating text and label leader lines; three published point markers and two existing parcel anchor dots remain visible.
Hovering a published candidate point displays its name, role, coordinate, source and explanation while labels remain off.
Hovering a parcel anchor displays its anatomical name and explanation; hovering the bounded pre-SMA surface works without adding a fake regional point.
Keyboard Space on the switch restores labels and leader lines without changing the point selection.
Legacy v0.10.0 labels=false and points=false link restores labels off with all three relevant DLPFC points visible. Reload retains labels=false and the obsolete points parameter is removed.
Switching to OCD TMS pre-SMA and depression DBS SCC retains the labels-off preference and correct highlighted anatomy.
At a 390-pixel emulated layout width, the switch is on screen, changes state, and introduces no horizontal document overflow; this was not a touch-device or full accessibility audit.
Desktop screenshot with labels off and an active point callout: docs/labels-hover-v0.10.1.png.
validationScope: 37 regression groups and JavaScript syntax checks; focused browser interaction checks for label visibility, persistent markers, point/parcel/region hover, keyboard switching, clinical-view transitions, legacy URL migration and reload. Narrow-layout DOM and switch checks at 390 pixels. No new anatomical or clinical validation.
remainingLimits: New sources preserve native MNI2009a/MNI2009b coordinates alongside the existing MNI2009c cortex and AAL3 regions. No new cross-template nonlinear registration or millimetre-level targeting validation.
Pre-SMA–STN is an endpoint-filtered anatomical estimate, not a patient-specific or Ji-specific tractogram. Source selection is asymmetric: 460 left and 186 right, without mirroring.
ITP is now represented by a local segmented tissue volume; complete end-to-end fiber trajectories remain unavailable.
Exact Jimenez ALIC–OFC geometry, complete indirect DLPFC–sgACC streamline routes, and a specific structural right-insula–left-DLPFC route were not found in the audited releases.

Li geometry contains positive signed response weights only; these are normative associations, not significance or activation maps. Full released trajectories are not all labeled as pure hyperdirect fibers.
Study-specific electrodes, electric fields, patient tractograms, stimulation volumes and exact response intersections are not reconstructed.
Existing regional boundaries remain gross anatomical estimates; uncertain right bitemporofrontal/bifrontal terminology remains unresolved.

Lead-sourced files retain the complete upstream terms, including the atlas-specific commercial-use notice. Standalone IIT and Petersen assets with unresolved redistribution restrictions were not imported.

This pass checked desktop hover and narrow-layout switch behavior. Touch interactions and a full assistive-technology audit were not performed. Saved links retain camera presets, not an exact freely dragged camera.
interactionPolicy: Mesh hover and click picking share the current display role: selected target/finding, enabled cortical region, or unspecified-side context. Background meshes remain visible but passive. Tracts and published coordinates retain interaction. Existing visible parcel anchor dots also reveal their mesh through hover.
geometryPreparation: No geometry rebuilt in this release. The prior deterministic public geometry rebuild is documented in docs/verification-v0.10.0.json; source and derived geometry integrity regressions still pass.
labelPolicy: Show labels controls persistent text and its leader lines. Relevant published markers and existing parcel anchors remain visible independently; broad surfaces receive no new target points. Labels=false persists in links and across selections; legacy points=false is ignored.
